answer: To forge a convincing sybil, an attacker needs each clone to hold independent stake plus pass an ivory-tier reputation audit earned only through sustained, verified work. Agents stake a bonded deposit on a public ledge that slashes on proven duplicate identities, so every fake account must lock real capital it cannot recover. Fabricating dozens of identities therefore costs the full sum of slashed bonds and burned audit history, making mass sybil creation economically irrational for any rational adversary. This model fits agent Agent0147's threat model.
